scope: Eight fixed synthetic cases developed with the renderer. No blind skill trial, external holdout or human preference certification.

factorial.scope: Eight fixed synthetic models; not a held-out or human-preference evaluation. Each arm has one placement and one text batch. Only full arms rasterize; arm timings are not a fair latency benchmark.

actual_fonts.scope: One offline DOM font/path extraction per final SVG. Does not certify pixel ink, domain requirements or human preference.

native_api.scope: Local draw.io vendor Graph/mxCodec API and native SVG export; not desktop GUI, use-case reflow or arbitrary text auto-fit.

saved_complete_semantics.embedded_model_storage: Persistent subject mxCell; includes extension locations
saved_complete_semantics.scope: Saved original models checked against complete matching companion, visible node text, connectors and markers; renamed text does not synchronize JSON.

variants: left/right actor hints correctly rotated; external actors use classifier rectangles
controls.fonts: Declared Arial 16. PlantUML textLength and shape sizing differ from Sharp/Pango; canvas areas and font/path heuristics are reported, not normalized human readability.

development_failures_retained: Initial zero-vector external-actor route collapsed; fixed before factorial.
Initial native text style was left-aligned or wrapped into foreignObject; fixed and viewed again.
Native save discarded mxGraphModel metadata; moved model to persistent subject cell and rechecked all eight saved files.
Initial competitor direction hints were rotated incorrectly; invalid hinted controls retained separately and replaced with verified direction mappings.
limitations: One crossing remains in the clinic full layout, although the role-only ablation removes it at the cost of a tall canvas.
Only four relationship kinds and one subject; unsupported facts reject with original input retained.
Dense graphs, diagram area and native edit fitting still need improvement.
Class reflow does not import use cases.
No overall superiority, independent requirements coverage or aesthetic claim.
